name: Pika Uruguay
description: Uruguayan shop selling board and card games, puzzles, children's books, colouring pads and build-it-yourself games, many with Uruguayan themes, organised by age. Ships nationwide and offers free pickup in Pocitos, Montevideo.
description_es: Tienda uruguaya de juegos de mesa y cartas, puzzles, libros infantiles, blocks para colorear y juegos para armar, muchos con temática uruguaya, organizados por edad. Envía a todo el país y ofrece retiro gratis en Pocitos, Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Montevideo by courier with a stated fee and free nationwide shipping above a stated order amount; interior dispatched by carriers on set weekdays, carrier fee paid by the buyer.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at a Pocitos, Montevideo point on weekdays and Saturday mornings, per the shipping page.

search.notes: Homepage returned 429; automated access looks restricted (challenge).

shopping_notes: Built on Wix Stores. The probe met a bot challenge, so automated access may be restricted; use the website links. Product pages have add-to-cart buttons; the shop lists products across several pages.
